checks.name: connection identity and deployed business-rule objects match the intended environment
session B cannot see the uncommitted employment of session A
session B is observed waiting on the business advisory lock
session B continues its INSERT after session A releases the lock
session B commit rejects conflicting employment using the fresh committed state
only the employment committed by session A remains
negative isolation test actually uses REPEATABLE READ
governed write under REPEATABLE READ is rejected explicitly
business-rule queue has no committed residual requests
all committed personal fixture rows are removed

limitations: Exercises one conflicting pair of employment transactions, not a load test.
Does not test application authorization or the privileges of a restricted API role.
Two independent server sessions are used; schema owners can still disable their own triggers.
A killed process or lost connection can require manual cleanup by the recorded fixture IDs.
transport: SSL disabled for this educational server
